bio: Admiral Gladstone sought the greatest power of the sea – the Blade of Aras – and he was willing to sacrifice a dozen ships and a thousand men to get it… but the Blade took his soul as well. Now, he leads only the dead, and every day seeks a way to claw back what he lost.
